package evaluator_test

import (
    "bytes"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
    "net/http/httptest"
    "strings"
    "sync"
    "sync/atomic"
    "testing"
    "time"

    "github.com/ding-labs/ding/internal/evaluator"
    "github.com/ding-labs/ding/internal/ingester"
    "github.com/ding-labs/ding/internal/metrics"
    "github.com/ding-labs/ding/internal/notifier"
)

func auditEngine(t *testing.T, condition string, cooldown time.Duration) *evaluator.Engine {
    t.Helper()
    e, err := evaluator.NewEngine([]evaluator.EngineRule{{Name: "watch", Condition: condition, Cooldown: cooldown}}, 10000)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    return e
}

func TestAuditCooldownUsesReplayClock(t *testing.T) {
    e := auditEngine(t, "value > 0", time.Minute)
    now := time.Now()
    ev := ingester.Event{Metric:"price", Value:1, At:now}
    if len(e.Process(ev,now)) != 1 { t.Fatal("first alert missing") }
    ev.At = now.Add(2*time.Minute)
    if n:=len(e.Process(ev,ev.At)); n != 1 {
        t.Fatalf("event two minutes later: got %d alerts; want 1 after one-minute cooldown",n)
    }
}

func TestAuditReloadUsesNewWindow(t *testing.T) {
    now:=time.Now()
    old:=auditEngine(t,"avg(value) over 1h > 40",0)
    old.Process(ingester.Event{Metric:"price",Value:100,At:now.Add(-10*time.Minute)},now.Add(-10*time.Minute))
    next:=auditEngine(t,"avg(value) over 1m > 40",0)
    evaluator.RestoreEngine(next,evaluator.SnapshotEngine(old),now)
    got:=next.Process(ingester.Event{Metric:"price",Value:0,At:now},now)
    if len(got)!=0 { t.Fatalf("new one-minute rule fired with avg=%v; ten-minute-old sample should have expired",got[0].Avg) }
}

func TestAuditLabelIdentityIsUnambiguous(t *testing.T) {
    a:=map[string]string{"a":"x,b=y"}
    b:=map[string]string{"a":"x","b":"y"}
    if evaluator.LabelSetKey(a)==evaluator.LabelSetKey(b) {
        t.Fatalf("distinct label maps collide as %q",evaluator.LabelSetKey(a))
    }
}

func TestAuditConcurrentCooldown(t *testing.T) {
    const concurrency=64
    for round:=0;round<500;round++ {
        e:=auditEngine(t,"value > 0",time.Minute)
        now:=time.Now()
        ev:=ingester.Event{Metric:"price",Value:1,At:now}
        var wg sync.WaitGroup
        var count atomic.Int64
        start:=make(chan struct{})
        for i:=0;i<concurrency;i++ {
            wg.Add(1)
            go func(){ defer wg.Done(); <-start; count.Add(int64(len(e.Process(ev,now)))) }()
        }
        close(start)
        wg.Wait()
        if n:=count.Load(); n!=1 { t.Fatalf("round %d: %d concurrent alerts within one-minute cooldown; want 1",round,n) }
    }
}

func TestAuditRateLimitIsNotSuccess(t *testing.T) {
    var attempts atomic.Int64
    srv:=httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter,r *http.Request){ attempts.Add(1); w.WriteHeader(http.StatusTooManyRequests) }))
    defer srv.Close()
    c:=metrics.NewCollector()
    n:=notifier.NewWebhookNotifier(srv.URL,3,time.Millisecond,c)
    n.Send(evaluator.Alert{Rule:"watch",FiredAt:time.Now()})
    n.Drain(time.Second)
    var buf bytes.Buffer
    c.WritePrometheus(&buf,0)
    if attempts.Load()!=3 { t.Errorf("HTTP 429 attempts=%d; want 3",attempts.Load()) }
    if strings.Contains(buf.String(),"ding_webhook_deliveries_total{result=\"success\"} 1") { t.Error("HTTP 429 counted as successful delivery") }
}

func TestAuditWindowBenchmarkActuallyHasSamples(t *testing.T) {
    e:=auditEngine(t,"avg(value) over 5m > 80",0)
    warmNow:=time.Now().Add(10*time.Minute)
    for j:=0;j<1000;j++ {
        e.Process(ingester.Event{Metric:"cpu_usage",Value:50,Labels:map[string]string{"host":"web-01"},At:time.Now().Add(time.Duration(j)*time.Millisecond)},warmNow)
    }
    count:=0
    for _,b:=range evaluator.SnapshotEngine(e).Buffers { count+=len(b.Entries) }
    if count!=1000 { t.Fatalf("benchmark warmup retained %d samples; advertised 1000",count) }
}

func TestAuditLabelRetentionObservation(t *testing.T) {
    e:=auditEngine(t,"avg(value) over 1m > 80",0)
    now:=time.Now()
    for i:=0;i<1000;i++ {
        e.Process(ingester.Event{Metric:"cpu",Value:50,Labels:map[string]string{"request_id":fmt.Sprint(i)},At:now},now)
    }
    later:=now.Add(24*time.Hour)
    e.Process(ingester.Event{Metric:"cpu",Value:50,Labels:map[string]string{"request_id":"new"},At:later},later)
    s:=evaluator.SnapshotEngine(e)
    stale:=0
    for _,b:=range s.Buffers { for _,entry:=range b.Entries { if entry.At.Before(later.Add(-time.Minute)) {stale++} } }
    t.Logf("one day later: %d buffers, %d expired samples retained",len(s.Buffers),stale)
}
